summary: Panjgur Airport (PJG/OPPG) is a medium-sized regional airport serving the remote Panjgur District in southwestern Balochistan, Pakistan, near the Iranian border. It provides vital air connectivity for this sparsely populated desert region, supporting both civilian travel and military operations in the border area. The airport primarily handles domestic flights and plays an important role in linking this isolated part of Balochistan to major Pakistani cities like Karachi and Quetta.
faqs:
Q: Where is Panjgur Airport located?
A: Panjgur Airport is located in the Panjgur District of Balochistan province in southwestern Pakistan, close to the Iranian border.

Q: What airlines operate at Panjgur Airport?
A: Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) has historically operated scheduled domestic flights to and from Panjgur, connecting the region with Karachi and other major cities.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: As a medium-sized regional airport, Panjgur offers basic passenger facilities including a terminal building, limited waiting areas, and ground transport access. Amenities are modest compared to major international airports.

Q: How high above sea level is Panjgur Airport?
A: The airport sits at an elevation typical of the Balochistan plateau, situated in a high-desert environment.
transport_tips: Taxis and private vehicles are the primary means of reaching Panjgur Airport, as the airport is located a short drive from the town center. Public transport options are limited, so arranging a pickup in advance is recommended, especially for early morning or late evening flights. The road network connecting the airport to the main town is generally well-maintained but services can be infrequent in this remote region.
local_tip: Carry sufficient water and sun protection when traveling through Panjgur, as the area experiences extreme desert heat, particularly during summer months when temperatures regularly exceed 40°C (104°F). Also, keep in mind that flight schedules to remote Balochistan destinations can be subject to delays due to weather or operational reasons, so build in buffer time for any connecting travel.
